verdict.rationale: The site offers a short online intake: "Tell us a bit about yourself to start your case assessment. It takes only a few minutes" on the founder work-visa page. That suggests a structured assessment entry point. However, the evidence does not show it is free, gives a self-serve eligibility result, or specifically scores O-1/EB-1 criteria; it reads more like a lead-intake form ahead of attorney review. The other assessment-like offerings, a 90-minute strategy session and a pathway-mapping review, are attorney-led consultations rather than self-serve tools. Missing for 10: confirmation the assessment is free, a self-serve qualifier that returns an eligibility result, explicit O-1/EB-1 criteria coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
